title: Russia’s Central Bank to Let Retail Investors Trade Bitcoin on Margin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Central Bank to Let Retail Investors Trade Bitcoin on Margin A Bank of Russia official said retail investors will be able to trade crypto on margin up to 300,000 rubles, with the first crypto funds for qualified investors expected in 2027. This post Russia’s Central Bank to Let Retail Investors Trade Bitcoin on Margin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
